text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A magnificent flower has fully bloomed under the overcast skies of Kyoto Racecourse! A Classic Triple Crown that will etch her name into our nation's Umamusume history has been achieved!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf magnificently achieved the title of "Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume."
And from that day forward—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —ORAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli spent her days pushing her limits
even further, stoically tackling intense training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, ...ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, humph!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
On the Classic Triple Crown route—
no, across the entirety of the Twinkle Series,
I will completely overwrite everything about *her*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She might not admit it...
but Symboli Rudolf's presence means a great deal to her."
choice_data_list: (Why am I even so concerned about her in the first place...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A fellow Umamusume of the Symboli family,
a childhood friend, and someone she just couldn't see eye to eye with."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would she really snap that hard over just that?
Could something have happened in the past—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Letting you see them off while spaced out...
Sirius really is magnanimous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silently emerging from the darkness was...
the daughter of the Mejiro family who radiated a noble aura—
Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Doing well, are they?
...Hardly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: She's never been one to talk much, ever since the old days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've heard that Mejiro Ramonu is childhood friends with Symboli Rudolf and Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she might know more
about the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Why Sirius cares so much about Rudolf... right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Since the stars are lovely tonight, just this once...
Let me tell you an old tale.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: On one condition, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Merciless"—
Rudolf was a child who suited such a word.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Freezing legs, breaking spirits...
A 'divine gift' bestowed by the heavens――"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hic, *gasp*, *wheeze*...!!
—Uuugh, waaaah, aaaaaagh...!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't run against Rudolf anymore...!
Her aura, her glare—it was all so terrifying...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right... It makes you realize...
that you could never, ever win...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No child ever grows fond of a wild beast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —That was precisely why Sirius was special.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"Hey!
One more time! Please train alongside me one more time!"

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
However... are you sure you're alright with it?"

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What are you talking about? Of course it is!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...! Haha!!
—Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*...!!
Ah, damn it, I wasn't even close...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
—...Haha!
I can't get enough of those beastly eyes of yours after all!
It makes me wanna bite right into you and make you flinch!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf! How's my running?
What do I gotta do to get as strong as you?

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
You are a wonderful Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That tremendous heat closing in from behind—
it isn't something one easily forgets.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? Cut that out.
I can't grow like that!
Tell me what I need to fix!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I stopped seeing her
running all alone on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And... yes.
This is a story of a glittering night.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rudolf. My dream...
is to become a first-magnitude star that shines brighter than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've been working super hard all this time!
But—"

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Meeting you made me realize that my current effort
isn't anywhere near enough!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to understand that now.
From here on out, I will work harder than anyone else.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'll surpass you! And when I do, I'll shine brighter than you, brighter than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it.
One day, I'll show you just how strong I've become.

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
—Thank you, Sirius."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Her voice was so gentle,
just like the moonlight, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: This is the old tale that I know.
choice_data_list: (To think they were actually good friends originally...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at her now, claiming she'll ‘erase her
past records,’ you would never imagine it."
choice_data_list: Why don't you two get along right now?
Why don't you get along right now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I said only one.
I don't like begging."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Troublesome matters as well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What did you hear?
choice_data_list: ...About how you used to be close with Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Tch... Forget it.
It doesn't matter at all right now."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Snooping around on your own? Did I make your leash too long?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Never ask around about my past second-hand again.
If you're curious, come ask me directly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up making Sirius Symboli angry...
but I was able to learn a piece of her past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Why did their relationship turn sour? I hope I'll have the chance to ask someday, somewhere.
